title: Metering Service Reporting Share for Customer-Reported Stopped Meters
content:
When the customer of record asked for the test that found a **Metering Service** meter not registering, the non-registering backbill carries a reporting share that depends on how many zero-kWh bills of the Electric Service Agreement had ended before the request.

**Zero-kWh bills reported late.** These are the zero-kWh bills of the covered period whose billing period ended before the month of the latest test request on the meter.

**Clause.** Where the customer of record requested the test that found the meter not registering and no more than the prompt-report number of 2 zero-kWh bills had ended before that request, the reporting share is the prompt-report share of 0.8. Where the customer of record requested that test and more than 2 zero-kWh bills had ended before it, the reporting share is the late-report share of 0.9. In every other case the reporting share is 1.

The test that found the meter not registering is the one asked for by the latest test request on the meter; it was customer-requested when that request carries the reason "customer request".

## Decision table

| Latest test request on the meter | Zero-kWh bills ended before the request | Reporting share |
|---|---|---|
| Customer request | 0, 1 or 2 | 0.8 |
| Customer request | 3 or more | 0.9 |
| Periodic or utility-initiated | Any | 1 |

## Hypothetical cases (monthly bills ending on the last day of the month)

- Zero-kWh bills ended 31 January and 28 February; the customer's request is dated 10 March: 2 had ended before it, share 0.8.
- Zero-kWh bills ended 31 January, 28 February and 31 March; the customer's request is dated 10 April: 3 had ended before it, share 0.9.
- The same bills, but the test was a periodic test: share 1.
